# Sergey Kanzhelev

> Canonical public profile and navigation hints for search engines, language models, and other automated readers.

Canonical website: https://sergey.kanzhelev.com/

Sergey Kanzhelev is a software engineer and open-source maintainer. His public work includes Kubernetes, OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing, W3C Trace Context, Application Insights, conference presentations, academic publications, and patents.
